user_story: As a visitor to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com, I want to navigate from the home page to an example page and back so that I can explore the catalogue of examples. Acceptance criteria: the home page shows the heading 'Welcome to the-internet'; clicking the link with text 'A/B Testing' navigates to a URL containing '/abtest' and shows an 'h3' heading; navigating back returns to the home page with the 'Available Examples' heading visible.
